instruction.name: clz.d
instruction.description: Count leading zeros in the low 64 bits of rj and write the count to rd.

experiments.name: dependent chain
experiments.notes: rd == rj; consecutive unrolled copies form a $r12 dependency chain.

latencies.notes: Measured with a 100000-instruction unrolled chain to remove call-boundary overlap.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: clz.d $r12, $r4; clz.d $r13, $r5; clz.d $r14, $r6; clz.d $r15, $r7; clz.d $r16, $r8; clz.d $r17, $r9; clz.d $r18, $r10; clz.d $r19, $r11
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8' --asm 'clz.d $r12, $r4; clz.d $r13, $r5; clz.d $r14, $r6; clz.d $r15, $r7; clz.d $r16, $r8; clz.d $r17, $r9; clz.d $r18, $r10; clz.d $r19, $r11'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 2.00 cycles: 0.25 cycles per instruction (4 IPC).

notes: Latency 1 cycle(s) and throughput 0.25 CPI for the operand combination(s) recorded above, measured with ./bench on LA664.
